text: {"name":"rf_apply_tx_calibration","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Loads a per-packet RF calibration value from a 1320-byte calibration table and patches it into the TX packet descriptor via check_packet_bits when the value is not the 1023 sentinel and the calibration state is not 2.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"v1":"cal_value"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":28,"meaning":"calibration selection index/channel byte used for table lookup"},{"offset":68,"meaning":"pointer to TX packet/descriptor whose calibration bits are updated"}]}
